C1501.title: Feasibility of Semi-Selfish Mining Attacks Under Undetected Conditions
C1501.summary: This study examines the feasibility of semi-selfish mining attacks, where a mining pool sponsors a selfish mining operation to gain excess rewards. Honest miners may exit upon detecting abnormal fork behavior, while the attacker leverages this strategy to continuously earn a disproportionate share of block rewards without being detected.

references.title: Is semi‐selfish mining available without being detected?
